summary: The diff implements most of REQ-7 and REQ-8. The frontend admin panel, bookings table, admin route, login/logout flow, isAdmin check, and Access Denied message are all present. The backend has a protected getAllBookings and an authorization mixin. However, REQ-7 specifically requires a hardcoded admin principal and an explicit isAdmin(caller) query method; the diff instead uses a prefab AccessControl/MixinAuthorization system with no hardcoded principal visible, and the frontend calls isCallerAdmin() rather than isAdmin(). The explicit isAdmin query returning true only for a hardcoded principal is not clearly implemented in the shown backend code.

missing_requirements.requirement: A single admin principal is hardcoded in the backend actor; an isAdmin query returns true only for the admin principal.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff uses a prefab MixinAuthorization/AccessControl system without showing any hardcoded admin principal. There is no explicit isAdmin query method visible in backend/main.mo. The frontend calls actor.isCallerAdmin(), not actor.isAdmin(). The requirement to hardcode a specific website owner principal and expose it via an isAdmin query is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: A URL parameter utility module (urlParams.ts) with sessionStorage persistence, caffeineAdminToken extraction, and hash parameter clearing, unrelated to admin panel or Internet Identity authentication.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only requires Internet Identity-based admin authentication. The urlParams.ts file introduces a token-based URL parameter system (caffeineAdminToken) that was not requested and is unrelated to the specified requirements.

hallucinated_features.description: useActor.ts calls actor._initializeAccessControlWithSecret(adminToken) using a caffeineAdminToken from URL/session storage.
hallucinated_features.reason: This token-based access control initialization was not requested. The spec requires only Internet Identity-based admin verification. Additionally, useActor.ts is listed as an immutable file in the constraints.
